brief: A tool caddy with a carry handle and divided bins for screws and bits.

requirements.evidence: Three linked full bases (piece:-1,0,0; piece:0,0,0; piece:1,0,0, level 0) form one carryable body, joint-bolted (lockJoints) and capped (capOpenFaces); check_build ok, meshClash clear, one group.
Central cell has a top cover (cover:0,0,0;full;top) carrying handle:0,0,0;top with its three inserts.

requirements.requirement: Divided bins for screws and bits
requirements.evidence: Two hex-bin-half-div3 bins (bin:-1,0,0 and bin:1,0,0), each with 3 compartments = 6 divided compartments; staged with M3 screw, nut and standoff heaps (prop:7-12) visible from above and from most angles in look.

finish.summary: A 3-cell tool caddy: a covered centre cell with a top carry handle flanked by two half-depth 3-compartment divided bins (6 compartments total), joint-bolted and end-capped, staged with screw/nut/standoff heaps in every compartment. Verified: check_build ok, meshClash clear.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
